title: Linear Regression from Scratch
blurb: Implement linear regression with gradient descent and the normal equation, and verify against scikit-learn.
brief: Implement linear regression twice using only NumPy: once with batch gradient descent and once with the closed-form solution. Train on a real regression dataset, plot the loss curve, show the effect of feature scaling and learning rate, and verify your weights match scikit-learn's. Add L2 regularization as an option.
requirements: A LinearRegression class with fit and predict methods
Batch gradient descent with a configurable learning rate and iteration count
A closed-form solver (normal equation, lstsq or pinv)
Feature standardization applied using training statistics only
MSE (and R-squared) computed by your own code and a recorded loss history
Optional L2 regularization and a comparison against scikit-learn
deliverables: The implementation as an importable module
A script or notebook that trains on a dataset and plots the loss curve
A short write-up of what happens with bad learning rates and unscaled features
Tests that check the two solvers agree
stretch: Add mini-batch and stochastic gradient descent
Add polynomial features and show overfitting
resume_bullet: Implemented linear regression from scratch in NumPy (gradient descent and closed form with L2 regularization), validated against scikit-learn.
